name: Remi
source: Remi is a highly distinguished Sentinel of Vera who has been stationed in Harth's village for as far back as he can remember.   Unlike many others fortunate enough to be born into the higher castes, Remi is uncharacteristically approachable and down to earth.  Although the presence of a Sentinel is extremely unusual in a peaceful frontier village, he dutifully keeps order when needed and is both a respected and beloved member of their tight-knit community.
